title: Skin Care for Surat Weather: A Routine for Humid Summers, Heavy Monsoon and Mild Winter
ex: Humid sea air for most of the year, a heavy monsoon and a short, mild winter: a simple skin care routine for people living in Surat.
rt: Skin Care for Surat Weather: Humid-City Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Surat weather: light layers for humid summers, monsoon and damp-skin care, a little more moisture in mild winter, plus Uttarayan and garba tips.
quick: Surat is humid for most of the year, with a hot sticky summer, a heavy monsoon and a short, mild winter. A gentle face wash, a light moisturiser, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and a thin layer of night cream suit most skin, with a little more moisture from December to February.
facts: Surat is on the Tapi river near the Arabian Sea
Humidity stays high for most of the year
The monsoon runs roughly mid-June to September
Uttarayan on 14 January means hours in direct sun
